name: search_overflow
description: Search session content moved out of context. Returns verbatim excerpts with file paths and line numbers.

query.description: Search term (plain substring by default; is_regex=true for regex). Searches the current session's overflow archive (content moved out of context during compression).

scope.description: Where to search (default: all). 'all' also includes folded-tool-groups/ and internal-note-overflow/; 'history' = overflow-history.md; 'tool_outputs' = tool-overflow-compressed/ (full snapshots of individual tool results).

file_pattern.description: Optional glob to restrict searched archive files (e.g. '*execute_command*').

is_regex.description: Treat query as a regex (default: false, literal substring).

context_lines.description: Context lines around each match (default: 2, max: 5).

max_results.description: Max matching lines across all files (default: 50, max: 200). If truncated, narrow the query (terms, scope, file_pattern) or reduce context_lines/max_results.
